title: IPA voice response and command recognition
summary: This topic centers on IPA voice interaction, with one positive example praising easier command recognition and two undetermined examples describing response inconsistencies or loss of function.

positive.summary: One positive review says the IPA system recognizes commands without forcing the user to repeat them as in older vehicles.

undetermined.summary: Two undetermined reviews describe IPA responding to some wording but not others and later quitting altogether, but the small sample does not clarify the underlying issue.

limitations: The evidence base is very small, with only one clearly positive review and two undetermined reviews.
The undetermined examples mix command-word recognition behavior with broader IPA performance loss, so the cluster may combine related but distinct issues.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so these examples should not be treated as prevalence estimates.
